chunks.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْعَطَّارُ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْبَاقِرِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ ع قَالَ

translations.en: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us; Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon him), who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ع مُجَالَسَةُ الْأَشْرَارِ تُورِثُ سُوءَ الظَّنِّ بِالْأَخْيَارِ وَ مُجَالَسَةُ الْأَخْيَارِ تُلْحِقُ الْأَشْرَارَ بِالْأَخْيَارِ وَ مُجَالَسَةُ الْفُجَّارِ لِلْأَبْرَارِ تُلْحِقُ الْفُجَّارَ بِالْأَبْرَارِ

translations.en: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Sitting with the evil-doers breeds bad opinion of the good, and sitting with the good attaches the evil-doers to the good, and sitting with the sinners by the righteous attaches the sinners to the righteous.

chunks.arabic_text: فَمَنِ اشْتَبَهَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَمْرُهُ وَلَمْ تَعْرِفُوا دِينَهُ فَانْظُرُوا إِلَى خُلَطَائِهِ فَإِنْ كَانُوا أَهْلَ دِينِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ عَلَى دِينِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ كَانُوا عَلَى غَيْرِ دِينِ اللَّهِ فَلَا حَظَّ لَهُ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ

translations.en: So if his matter is ambiguous for you and you do not know his religion, look to his companions; if they are people of the religion of Allah, then he is upon the religion of Allah, and if they are upon other than the religion of Allah, then he has no share in the religion of Allah.

chunks.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ص كَانَ يَقُولُ مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلَا يُؤَاخِيَنَّ كَافِرًا وَلَا يُخَالِطَنَّ فَاجِرًا

translations.en: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to say: He who believes in Allah and the Last Day should not fraternize with a disbeliever nor associate with a sinful one.

chunks.arabic_text: وَمَنْ آخَى كَافِرًا أَوْ خَالَطَ فَاجِرًا كَانَ كَافِرًا فَاجِرًا.

translations.en: And whoever fraternizes with a disbeliever or associates with a sinful one, he is regarded as a disbeliever and sinful.

en.summary: Attributed to Imam al-Baqir and Imam Ali, this narration from *Sifat al-Shia* highlights the sociological principle of 'proximity determines status,' where the company one keeps serves as a diagnostic tool for one's true faith when internal conviction is unclear. It underscores the Shia emphasis on *khilata* (close companionship) as a transformative force, warning that deep association with the wicked can lead to spiritual assimilation, a concept rooted in the Prophet's warning against intimate alliance with disbelievers.
en.seo_question: How does social association affect a person's religious status according to Shia hadith?
